thumbnail.alt: Two toolbars stacked, each labelled with one word. Above, labelled Drupal: the buttons sit in grey tiles and the separators are tiles of their own. Below, labelled Frontend: the same buttons in the same order in a plain row with thin dividers. In both, reading left to right: bold, italic, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, code, remove format, link, bulleted list, numbered list, block quote, image, table, horizontal line, a heading dropdown, code block and source editing.

field_media_caption.value: The same toolbar, twice. Drupal draws the separators as draggable tiles because that screen is for editing the toolbar; the frontend draws them as dividers.
